prompt:
Goal: Create a polished vertical manga page in a delicate semi-realistic anime style about a late-night meal temptation, with clean black panel borders, soft cinematic lighting, and readable Japanese manga text.

Canvas: Portrait manga page, roughly 3:4 aspect ratio, white outer margin. Put the title 「夜食」 at the top left and page number 「1/4」 at the top right. Add a small centered signature at the bottom: @_sagyo.

Layout: Use exactly 4 panels. Panel 1 is a wide full-width top panel occupying about half the page height. Panels 2 and 3 are two equal smaller panels side by side in the middle row. Panel 4 is a wide full-width bottom panel. Use thick black gutters between panels.

Panel 1: A dim blue midnight kitchen-dining room. A slim young woman named a soft-featured young woman stands in front of a silver refrigerator, one hand resting on her stomach. She has long dark brown hair, pale skin, a modest brown long dress with a dark vest-like bodice, plaid sheer sleeves, ankle socks, and brown lace-up shoes. The kitchen includes exactly these visible environment elements: 1 sink and counter on the left, 1 window showing night sky, 1 silver refrigerator behind her, 1 shelving unit on the right, 1 microwave, 1 coffee maker, 1 wooden dining table, 2 dining chairs, 1 dark mug on the table, and several small bottles/jars on shelves. Text: a vertical narration box on the right reads 「深夜零時—」, a wavy stomach sound near the woman reads 「ぐぅ〜」, and a white irregular speech bubble on the left reads 「小腹…すいた…」.

Panel 2: Close-up bust portrait of a handsome demon man on a purple background. He has very long white hair, pale skin, black curved horns, elegant sharp eyes, and a teasing expression with one finger near his lips. He wears a dark shirt, brown vest, orange tie or cord accent, and a small orange pocket square. Include exactly 3 devil motifs: 1 small black cat-devil silhouette, 1 trident symbol, and 1 black bat wing. Text in a white speech bubble reads 「今食べたいものが一番おいしいに決まっています」.

Panel 3: Matching close-up bust portrait of the same man as an angel on a warm golden background. He has long white hair, pale skin, a glowing halo, white feathered wings, and hands clasped as if praying, with a gentle worried expression. Include exactly 4 floating white feathers and several small sparkles. Text in a white speech bubble reads 「夜食は睡眠に響きますよ…今夜はお白湯でそっとお布団へ…」.

Panel 4: Wide bottom scene at a wooden table with the woman on the left holding chopsticks and looking uncertain, and the demon man seated on the right, leaning his cheek on his hand with a smug smile. He has black horns, long white hair, black bat wings, and a pointed devil tail visible behind him. Purple-gray background with soft screentone texture. Text: the woman’s white bubble on the left reads 「くっ…」, a spiky vertical bubble on the far right reads 「悪魔ちゃん…！」, and a rounded bubble near the demon reads 「ふふ もう箸をお持ちですよ」.

Visual style: High-quality Japanese web manga, elegant line art, soft gradients, subtle screentone textures, detailed clothing folds, expressive faces, moody nighttime palette in the kitchen, purple devil palette for temptation, warm gold angel palette for restraint. Keep the characters consistent across panels.

Constraints: Use exactly 4 panels, exactly 3 major characters/roles shown across the page: the woman, the demon version of the white-haired man, and the angel version of the same man. Preserve the Japanese text exactly as written. Do not add extra panels, extra characters, random English text, logos, or watermarks beyond @_sagyo.
